entries.proposition: The neural-induction system uses H9 hESC differentiated by dual SMAD inhibition.
entries.snippet: Differentiation of the H9 cells towards NEP was based on dual SMAD inhibition

entries.proposition: The transcriptome concentration is the highest non-cytotoxic concentration (EC10 of cytotoxicity), not a clinical exposure.
entries.snippet: The highest non-cytotoxic concentration [corresponding to EC10(cytotoxicity)] of all test compounds was determined in a viability assay.

entries.proposition: The authors' VPA concentration-response series used eight concentrations from 25 to 1000 uM, with the classifier calling VPA an HDACi from 350 uM upward.
entries.snippet: The eight concentrations ranged from 25 to 1000 µM

entries.proposition: The supplement defines the cut-off as p 0.05 with fold change 1.5.
entries.snippet: SHEET=Table of Content-sheet 1 | ROW=17 | C=Cut off: p 0.05_ fold change 1.5
entries.anchor: Supplemental Table S1, table of content, row 17

entries.proposition: The supplement's own fold-change line is internally ambiguous ('>1 down regulated; >1 up regulated'); direction is therefore settled by sentinels, not by that line.
